title: Colombo
transcription:
Columbo

In fourteen hundred and ninety-two!
(Repeat)
A sailor from New Delhi
(Repeat)
Was walkin' around the streets of Spain
(Repeat)
And sellin' hot tamales,
(Repeat)

Chorus:
Well he said the world was round-o!
(Repeat)
And he said it could be found-o!
(Repeat)
That hypothetical calculating
son-of-a-gun, Columbo!
(Repeat)

(Continue with repeats)

Well he walked right up
to the queen of Spain
And he asked for ships and cargo
And he said I'll be a son-of-a-gun
If I don't bring back Chicago.

Chorus

The First Mate, The First Mate,
A beard 'e had a big 'un.
He wrapped it twice around the mast
And he used the rest for riggin'.

Chorus
